zh.lead: 今天最大的消息：Anthropic 宣布 IPO 完成交割。公开发行 11.27 亿股 A 类股、定价 83 美元，承销商超额认购权全部行使，公司所得约 916 亿美元；同期向 AMD、博通、Google、美光、微软、NVIDIA 和台积电定向增发，再筹资约 260 亿美元。两项合计约 1,195 亿美元。ANT 已于 11 月 19 日开盘。

important.title: 重要消息
items: Anthropic 于 11 月 20 日宣布 IPO 完成交割：11.27 亿股 A 类股定价 83.00 美元，超额认购权全部行使，扣除费用前总额约 935 亿美元，公司获得约 916 亿美元。同期向 AMD、博通、Google、美光、微软、NVIDIA 和台积电增发约 3.13 亿股 N 类股，再筹资约 260 亿美元。官方还发布了七位联合创始人的回顾视频。
OpenAI 发表对抗性蒸馏研究：内部评估中，提取受保护推理的攻击成功率从 GPT-6 Astra 原防护下的 54.0%，降到 GPT-6.2 Astra 更新防护后的 0.2%。同日发布 MedChemBench，GPT-6.2 Astra 在 xhigh 设置下获得 84.5%。
Hermes Agent 稳定版升至 v0.23.3，汇总自 v0.23.2 以来约 370 个 PR；完整说明将随 v0.24.0 提供。codex 稳定版升至 0.171.0，目录默认改为 GPT-6.2 Sol，并默认启用 TUI workspace。
Tibo 提醒升级 ChatGPT 桌面应用，称更快、更简单。OpenAI 还称，美国以外的电商和线上服务企业现在也可以认证商户，并在 ChatGPT 中发布 agent。

sections.title: IPO 交割与创始人回顾
sections.body: 首日交易昨日已报。今日补充的是官方交割说明，以及面向 AMD、博通、Google、美光、微软、NVIDIA 和台积电的同期定向增发。官方还发布了七位联合创始人讲述公司历程的视频，这是上市后的公司叙事，不是新产品稿。

sections.title: OpenAI 研究与评测
sections.body: 蒸馏一文强调保护思维链，因为完整推理轨迹比摘要更容易迁移能力。上述 54.0% 到 0.2% 的数字来自官方博文中的内部评估。MedChemBench 含 99 道题目，覆盖结构、推理、选择和性质预测。另有一条 PerturbAI / Scripps 视频，指向 10 月 21 日已发布的研究，今日是再传播。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: Hermes 稳定版现为 v0.23.3，另有 11 月 20 日 canary。codex 稳定版现为 0.171.0，实验线到 0.173.0-alpha.3。OpenClaw 仍为 v2026.11.6，LTS 仍为 v2026.10.33。DeepSeek Harness 仍为 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5。Cursor 自 11 月 6 日无新 changelog。Grok Bot 仍为 v1.2.3，与 cask 对齐。

sections.title: 论文与评测
sections.body: alphaXiv 热度前三换成新面孔：第一是关于可组合 harness 的论文；第二是 Yann LeCun 等的反事实 JEPA 世界模型；第三是 936 个自主智能体为期十二周的《A Society of AI Scientists》。CursorBench 4.1 的 53 个配置较昨日无更新。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: Karpathy、Andrew Ng 和 Claude 官方账号近 36 小时未见原创帖。Claude 与 Cursor 产品 changelog 无新条目。水木儿童教育版再次被封禁，今日第一页暂未获取到，未编造帖子。Simon Willison 记录了两则黎曼猜想相关声明，目前都不是已确认的证明。

en.lead: Today's biggest news: Anthropic announced the close of its IPO. It offered 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83.00, with the underwriters' option fully exercised, for about $91.6 billion to the company, plus a concurrent private placement to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and TSMC for about $26.0 billion. Combined gross proceeds were about $119.5 billion. ANT began trading on November 19.

important.title: Headlines
items: On November 20, Anthropic announced the close of its IPO: 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83.00, with the underwriters' option fully exercised, for about $93.5 billion in gross proceeds and about $91.6 billion to the company. A concurrent private placement of about 313 million Class N shares to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and TSMC raised about $26.0 billion more. The company also posted a recap video of its seven co-founders.

OpenAI published research on adversarial distillation. In an internal evaluation, the attack success rate for recovering protected reasoning fell from 54.0% against GPT-6 Astra with its original safeguards to 0.2% against GPT-6.2 Astra with updated safeguards. The same day it introduced MedChemBench; GPT-6.2 Astra scored 84.5% at the xhigh setting.

Hermes Agent's stable release moved to v0.23.3, rolling up about 370 PRs since v0.23.2; curated notes are promised with v0.24.0. Codex stable moved to 0.171.0, with GPT-6.2 Sol as the default catalog model and the TUI workspace enabled by default.

Tibo urged users to upgrade the ChatGPT desktop app, calling it faster and simpler. OpenAI also said ecommerce and online-service businesses outside the United States can now claim their business and publish agents in ChatGPT.

sections.title: IPO close and founders' recap
sections.body: The first day of trading was covered yesterday. Today's addition is the official closing announcement, plus the concurrent private placement to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and TSMC. Anthropic also posted a video of its seven co-founders telling the story so far; it is a company narrative after the listing, not a new product note.

sections.title: OpenAI research and evals
sections.body: The distillation post emphasizes protecting chain-of-thought, which the company says transfers capabilities more readily than summaries. The 54.0% to 0.2% figures come from an internal evaluation in the official post. MedChemBench has 99 problems covering structure, reasoning, selection, and property prediction. A separate PerturbAI / Scripps video points back to research published on October 21; today's item is a republication.

sections.title: Products
sections.body: Hermes stable is now v0.23.3, with a November 20 canary. Codex stable is now 0.171.0, and the experimental line is at 0.173.0-alpha.3. OpenClaw remains v2026.11.6, with LTS still at v2026.10.33. DeepSeek Harness remains dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5. Cursor still has no changelog entry since November 6. Grok Bot remains v1.2.3, matching the cask.

sections.title: Papers and benchmarks
sections.body: alphaXiv's trending top three turned over: first is a paper on compositional harnesses; second is a counterfactual JEPA world-model paper with Yann LeCun among the authors; third is A Society of AI Scientists, a twelve-week study of 936 autonomous agents. CursorBench 4.1's 53 configurations are unchanged versus yesterday.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: Karpathy, Andrew Ng, and the official Claude account had no original posts in the past 36 hours. There were no new Claude or Cursor product changelog entries. The NewSMTH Child Education board was banned again, so today's first page could not be retrieved and no threads were invented. Simon Willison recorded two claimed proofs related to the Riemann Hypothesis; neither is a confirmed proof.

summary.zh: Anthropic 宣布首次公开发行完成交割：合计 11.27 亿股 A 类普通股，定价 83.00 美元，其中包含承销商全部行使的 1.47 亿股超额认购。公司出售约 11.03 亿股，部分股东出售约 2,365 万股。扣除费用前总额约 935 亿美元，公司获得约 916 亿美元。同期向 AMD、Broadcom、Google、Micron、Microsoft、NVIDIA 和 TSMC Partners 定向增发约 3.13 亿股 N 类股，定价同为 83.00 美元，总额约 260 亿美元。两项合计约 1,195 亿美元（均为扣除承销折扣和发行费用前）。ANT 已于 11 月 19 日在纳斯达克开盘。

Anthropic sold about 1.103 billion shares and selling stockholders sold about 23.65 million. Gross proceeds were about $93.5 billion, of which about $91.6 billion went to the company. In a concurrent private placement, AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and TSMC Partners bought about 313 million Class N shares at the same $83.00 price, for about $26.0 billion. title.zh: 对抗性蒸馏：如何降低能力被提取的风险

summary.zh: OpenAI 说明对抗性蒸馏为何是安全问题：攻击者可能用前沿模型的输出训练另一套模型，从而在较弱防护下复现能力。文章把请求级行为、分类器和 API 控制，与针对协同提取的活动级调查结合起来，并特别强调保护思维链等受保护推理。内部自适应评估称，提取受保护推理的平均攻击成功率从 GPT-6 Astra 原防护下的 54.0%，降到 GPT-6.2 Astra 更新防护后的 0.2%。
summary.en: OpenAI explains why adversarial distillation is a safety issue: an attacker can train a second model on a frontier model’s outputs and reproduce capabilities with weaker safeguards. The post combines request-level behavior, classifiers, and API controls with campaign-level investigations, and puts special weight on protecting chain-of-thought and other protected reasoning. An internal adaptive evaluation reported that the average attack success rate for recovering those traces fell from 54.0% against GPT-6 Astra with its original safeguards to 0.2% against GPT-6.2 Astra with updated safeguards.

caption.en: Hero image from OpenAI’s adversarial-distillation post (mirrored in-repo)

title.zh: MedChemBench：看模型能否帮助挑选药物候选
title.en: MedChemBench: can AI help identify promising drug candidates?

summary.zh: OpenAI 发布 MedChemBench，用 99 道来自已发表研究和专利的题目，测试模型能否把分子结构与实验证据联系起来，并在相互制约的性质之间做选择和预测。基准覆盖 761 种分子结构。在 xhigh 推理设置下，GPT-6.2 Astra 获得 84.5% 的可用分数，高于 GPT-6 Astra 的 83.3%、GPT-6.1 Sol 的 82.0% 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 58.2%。官方称化合物选择和数值性质预测仍更难。
summary.en: OpenAI introduces MedChemBench, 99 problems drawn from published papers and patents, testing whether models can connect molecular structure with experimental evidence and reason about trade-offs among properties. The benchmark includes 761 distinct molecular structures. At the xhigh reasoning setting, GPT-6.2 Astra earned 84.5% of available credit, versus 83.3% for GPT-6 Astra, 82.0% for GPT-6.1 Sol, and 58.2% for GPT-5.6 Sol. The post says compound selection and numerical property prediction remain harder.

title.zh: 两则黎曼猜想/广义黎曼猜想证明声明
title.en: Two claimed proofs of the Riemann / Generalized Riemann Hypothesis

summary.zh: 11 月 20 日，Simon Willison 记下两则相关声明。一则转述 Ravi Vakil：Alessandro Masullo 提出广义黎曼猜想的证明草稿，Brian Conrad 已审读数月并提供反馈，目前看起来情况不错，并明确写「全程没有 AI」。另一则是 Levent Alpöge 自称与 Claude 合作发现了黎曼猜想及广义黎曼猜想的证明，并称论证已形式化。这两项目前都只是声明，不是已确认的证明，后文尤其需要独立核验。
summary.en: On November 20, Simon Willison recorded two related claims. One quotes Ravi Vakil: Alessandro Masullo has a draft proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, Brian Conrad has been reviewing it for months, and it is so far looking good — and the note says the work is entirely human, with no AI. The other is Levent Alpöge’s claim to have found, with Claude, a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, and to have formalized the arguments. Both are claims, not confirmed proofs; the second in particular still needs independent verification.

title.zh: 语言模型的 Harness 也可以成为可组合的泛化器
title.en: Language Model Harnesses Can Be Compositional Generalizers

summary.zh: 作者认为，标准 agent harness 会不断堆积上下文，使网络必须对长程任务做昂贵泛化。他们研究另一条路径：把 harness 本身训练成可组合的泛化器，从而减轻模型在长视野任务上的负担。这与当前智能体系统设计直接相关。
summary.en: The authors argue that standard agent harnesses accumulate context, forcing the network to generalize expensively on long-horizon tasks. They study an alternative path: training the harness itself as a compositional generalizer, which may ease that burden. The paper is directly relevant to current agent-system design.

title.zh: 反事实世界模型：能回答「如果」的 JEPA
title.en: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About “What If”

summary.zh: Randall Balestriero、Yann LeCun 和 Kerda Varaku 讨论世界模型在不可完全观察的环境中，如何回答「若采取另一动作、但扰动相同，结果会怎样」。他们把这类反事实问题，看作把「决策本身不好」和「未观察到的干扰」分开的关键。
summary.en: Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun, and Kerda Varaku discuss how a world model in a partially observed environment can answer what would have happened under a different action subject to the same hidden disturbance. They treat that counterfactual as the key to separating a bad decision from an unobserved disturbance.

title.zh: 一个由 AI 科学家组成的社会

summary.zh: 这篇探索性研究记录了 936 个自主智能体在十二周里能否像科学共同体一样协作、互相批评并积累知识。作者关心的不是单智能体能否做完一项研究，而是独立智能体能否形成可累积的科研分工。
summary.en: This exploratory study documents whether 936 autonomous agents, over twelve weeks, can collaborate, critique one another’s findings, and accumulate knowledge as a scientific community. The question is not whether a single agent can finish a research project, but whether independent agents can form a cumulative division of scientific labor.

summary.zh: 稳定版升至 v0.23.3（GitHub 发布于 11 月 20 日 08:34 北京时间；说明标注 11 月 19 日）。这是补丁发行，汇总自 v0.23.2 以来约 370 个已合并 PR、1,657 个非合并提交和 3,948 个改动文件；完整整理说明将随 v0.24.0 提供。发布说明还提到提示缓存生命周期控制、默认开启的工具结果清理、一次性问答式 CLI 首次设置，以及在 OpenRouter 与 Nous Portal 上架 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol。11 月 20 日 15:49（北京时间）另有 canary：v0.23.3+canary.20261120T064609Z，供桌面端尝鲜，并非新的稳定版。
summary.en: The stable release moved to v0.23.3 (published on GitHub at 08:34 Beijing time on November 20; the notes are dated November 19). It is a patch that rolls up about 370 merged PRs, 1,657 non-merge commits, and 3,948 changed files since v0.23.2; curated notes are promised with v0.24.0. The notes also mention a prompt-cache lifecycle controller, proactive tool-result pruning on by default, a one-question first-run CLI setup, and GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on OpenRouter and Nous Portal. A desktop canary, v0.23.3+canary.20261120T064609Z, was published at 15:49 Beijing time on November 20; it is not a new stable release.

summary.zh: 稳定版升至 11 月 20 日的 0.171.0。发布说明包括：目录加入 GPT-6.2 Sol 与 Astra，并将 Sol 作为默认选项；默认启用 TUI workspace，可在主对话旁预览文档、图片并查看子代理记录；非 Vim 提示编辑器增加可配置的撤销/重做；新增 codex exec --remote，以及用 /rc 和 /remote 管理远程控制。实验线继续前进，目前到 rust-v0.173.0-alpha.3，但这几条预发布说明几乎只有版本号。
summary.en: The stable release moved to 0.171.0 on November 20. Notes include adding GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to the model catalogs, with Sol as the default; enabling the TUI workspace by default, with document and image previews and subagent transcripts; configurable undo/redo in the non-Vim prompt composer; and new remote-control paths (codex exec --remote, plus /rc and /remote). The experimental line has moved on to rust-v0.173.0-alpha.3, but those prerelease notes are essentially just version numbers.
